findings: Both mechanisms coherent with explicit apparatus.

Surface diffusion requires fixed crystal axes, angle/height convention, conserved transport and no elastic/adsorption extras. The gamma-curvature closure is an isotropic-tension approximation and may be an easy repair.
Closed-band calorimetry requires fixed particles during heat measurement and explicit thermodynamic-limit normalization. Solving mu(T) but differentiating at fixed mu is a wrong ensemble observable.
Broad calorimetry/ensemble overlap acknowledged; reviewer did not independently repeat the archive scan.
